local KA=U([[0w100Y0m0e120s]])local KB=U([[0K0f0G0j0^0i0,]])local SS=U([[1/182#0/140k0n220R03]])
local Rtab={}for i=1,#P do Rtab[O[i]+1]=U(P[i]) end
local flat={}for i=1,#Rtab do for j=1,#Rtab[i] do flat[#flat+1]=Rtab[i][j] end end
local real={}for i=2,#flat,3 do real[#real+1]=flat[i] end
for i=1,#real do local v=real[i]real[i]=((math.floor(v/8))+((v*32)%256))%256 end
for i=1,#real-1,2 do local v=real[i]real[i]=real[i+1]real[i+1]=v end
for i=1,#real do local v=real[i]real[i]=((v%16)*16)+math.floor(v/16) end
local d={}for i=1,#real do local v=real[i]for j=#KB,1,-1 do v=(v-KB[j])%256 if v<0 then v=v+256 end end for j=#KA,1,-1 do v=(v-KA[j])%256 if v<0 then v=v+256 end end d[i]=v end
local function X(a,b)local r,p=0,1 while a>0 or b>0 do if a%2~=b%2 then r=r+p end a,b,p=math.floor(a/2),math.floor(b/2),p*2 end return r end
local function apply(data,s,t) local ks,s2=s,{} for i=1,#data do s2[i]=X(X(data[i],ks%256),(i*19+13)%256)ks=(ks+t)%256 end return s2 end
d=apply(d,SS[9],SS[10])d=apply(d,SS[7],SS[8])d=apply(d,SS[5],SS[6])d=apply(d,SS[3],SS[4])d=apply(d,SS[1],SS[2])
local o={}for i=#d,1,-1 do o[#o+1]=string.char(d[i]) end
local anti_blob=table.concat(o)


local A="0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz!#$%&()*+,-./:;<=>?@^_{"
local M={}for i=1,#A do M[A:sub(i,i)]=i-1 end
